[SWS_CM_12003] Active subscriber when SOME/IP Network binding is used
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00103, RS_AP_00114, RS_AP_00120
⌈
In addition to [SWS_CM_12002], if SOME/IP Network binding is used to provide
services for an application, the active subscriber shall be an adaptive application for
which the SOME/IP services subscription has not yet expired when the
